description: This file contains PyTorch code that defines custom ONNX operators and their implementation for specific neural network components such as GELU, GroupNorm, RMSNorm, and scaled dot-product attention. It includes function definitions, external library imports, and operator registration for ONNX compatibility within the PyTorch framework.
